		default_option = yes

		}
	}
}

cwp_algeria.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_algeria.2.t
	desc = cwp_algeria.2.d
	flavor = cwp_algeria.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_political_extremism"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_military.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_algeria.2.a
		default_option = yes
		set_variable = cwp_algeria_strongman
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = cwp_algeria_army_ascendant
				years = 3
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
			modifier = {
				trigger = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes }
				add = 30
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_algeria.2.b
		add_radicals = {
			value = 0.1
			interest_group = ig:ig_armed_forces
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				trigger = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes }
				add = 30
			}
		}
	}
}

	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_algeria.10.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_algeria.10.d_fra
				trigger = { c:FRA ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_algeria.10.d_ald
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_algeria.10.f_fra
				trigger = { c:FRA ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_algeria.10.f_ald
			}

			base = 1
		}
	}
}
